title: Heir Hunting Operator Companion Workbook
subtitle: 6 Field Worksheets, Deal Qualification Matrices & 30-Day Execution Logs

worksheets.title: Case Intake & Jurisdiction Screen
worksheets.purpose: Classify the opportunity before research spending or contact.
worksheets.instructions: Complete from verified records; mark unknowns and hold work requiring unresolved legal approval.

fields.guidance: Use a non-sensitive internal ID and official source citation.
Record known facts, evidence, and unresolved choice-of-law questions.
Distinguish probate estate, state-held unclaimed property, or unknown.
Name the reviewer, review date, scope, and outstanding conditions.
Choose accept, hold, or decline and explain the evidence for that decision.

worksheets.title: Kinship Evidence & Conflict Register
worksheets.purpose: Connect every material relationship to evidence and unresolved issues.
worksheets.instructions: Use one copy per relationship; distinguish direct evidence, inference, and missing evidence.

fields.guidance: Identify people by case IDs and state the exact relationship being tested.
Include collection, record identifier, page, and retrieval date.
Explain reliability, informant knowledge, and corroboration.
Preserve contradictions and negative-search results.
Record reviewer, date, evidence status, and required follow-up.

worksheets.title: Distribution & Deal Qualification Matrix
worksheets.purpose: Separate hypothetical inheritance shares from lawful collectible fees and costs.
worksheets.instructions: Use counsel-confirmed distribution rules; label every estimate and model noncollection.

fields.guidance: Enter the assumed or verified amount and document debts and expense assumptions separately.
State the governing rule, recipients, fractions, and arithmetic reconciliation.
Identify represented interests and reviewed compensation terms; never presume legality.
Include labor, records, review, overhead, delay, and zero collection.
Choose proceed, revise, or decline with budget cap and approval owner.

worksheets.title: Ethical Outreach & Contract Review
worksheets.purpose: Ensure contact and engagement are truthful, lawful, and voluntary.
worksheets.instructions: Complete before external contact; keep sensitive identification data out of this worksheet.

fields.guidance: Use a case ID and safe independent verification method.
Record applicable calling, texting, email, privacy, and consent checks.
Identify the private business, state uncertainty, and avoid guaranteed outcomes.
Record jurisdiction, asset regime, counsel approval, fee terms, and required disclosures.
Record permission, opt-out, no response, or follow-up date without pressure.

worksheets.title: Case Operations & Quality-Control Log
worksheets.purpose: Allocate work while preserving independent review and secure evidence handling.
worksheets.instructions: Update weekly and after a material error; distinguish completion from approval.

fields.guidance: Name research, review, operations, principal, and legal escalation owners.
List remaining tasks, expected hours, dependencies, and due dates.
Record source-linked extraction checks and any unsupported output.
Document permission changes, backup checks, and retention decisions.
State impact, containment, owner, deadline, and restart approval.

completion_checklist: Close or explicitly hold corrective actions.

worksheets.title: 30-Day Execution & Decision Log
worksheets.purpose: Track a controlled pilot through a documented continuation decision.
worksheets.instructions: Use dated entries for every day from 1 through 30, including blocked days; do not treat forecasts as collections.

fields.guidance: For each day record date, planned task, actual work, evidence link, hours, and blockers.
Record day-7, day-14, day-21, and day-30 deliverables and unresolved prerequisites.
Separate paid costs, commitments, collected cash, and uncollected projections.
Assign each issue an owner, due date, and stop or escalation condition.
Choose continue, revise, or stop; document approvals, rationale, and next-period budget.
